# Hamza Yeşilmen

> Senior AI Engineer and Engineering Lead at Mountain AI (mountain.com.tr), based in Türkiye and open to freelance and full-time work. Mechatronics engineer with 5+ years across AI, embedded systems and backend. Builds production LLM, RAG and AI-agent (MCP) systems, FastAPI backends, and ESP32 hardware-to-cloud products.
